#A brief introduction explaining what R Markdown is.

R Markdown is a document that has interactive portions of code in it.


A narrative paragraph in "markdown text" would be something like this that explains a chunk of information in a normal non code text. This is so you can explain what is going on or just ramble incoherently because you have no idea what to write.
